purpose: Gives the held stakeholder card everything it needs from GilbPlatform, inside the stakeholder card provider.
namedChanges: 0.4.1 (H13): tests only, and the peer range of the provider (^0.4.3). The whole path now also covers "+ Add your own" on a record the holder already holds (the door is the vault the find named), and the Added by line (not a bug: the held card finds the adder's address in the shared query client).

This unit is new composition code, not an extraction: it copies no line of GilbApp. It builds the host of `stakeholder-record-card` (`StakeholderRecordCardHost`) from `useStakeholderCardPlatform()` of `stakeholder-card-hosts-gilbplatform` and mounts it above the card (`HeldStakeholderCard`).

It exists apart from the provider so that the provider does not import `stakeholder-record-card`: the record card's own tests install the provider, and a provider that imported the card would be a dependency cycle.

`HeldStakeholderCard` draws the sentence "The MyNet profile address is not set, so this card is not drawn." and no card when `settings.mynetProfileUrl` was not given to the provider, because the card's own-card band (`own-card-state`) throws when no address is set. GilbApp built the address from the profile app's base address at module load.

test/ holds the master and platform fixtures of the provider's tests (`world.ts`, `support.ts`, `fixture*.ts`, `writableFields.ts`, `fakeSession.ts`, `memoryStorage.ts`), copied unchanged, and `heldWorld.ts` with the contact catalogue, which the held card's tests need; they are not shipped as source.

0.2.0: the host gives `renderLanguages` (`LanguageSection` of `language-section`, the slot's props as they are, no `renderCountrySearch`). New: `test/languagesWorld.ts`; `test/fixturePlatform.ts` gains a `DELETE /lws/r/<id>` route (a test fixture).

0.3.0: the host gives `renderSkillsAndInterests` (`Fragment` of `SkillRows` of `skill-rows` and `InterestRows` of `interest-rows`, each with its half of the slot's props as they are). New: `src/heldCard.skills.test.tsx`, `test/skillsWorld.ts` (test fixtures); the lockfile is made again.

0.4.0: the host gives `renderEmployment` (a small component of the host that gives `EmploymentRows` of `employment-rows` the slot's props as they are, `find` = `findOrganizationRecords` of `org-hierarchy`, and `vaultName` = the shell's name for the holding vault when it lists one; no work-place slot). Peers gain `employment-rows` ^0.1.0 and `org-hierarchy` ^0.1.2; the host-agnostic script allows the two imports. New: `src/heldCard.employment.test.tsx`; `test/world.ts` also serves the terms of an employment entity (test fixture); the lockfile is made again.

host.implementedBy: `createCardVocabularyHost` of the provider, with the platform's `persistVocabulary` when given

host.member: StakeholderRecordCardHost.holdingVaultOf and the render slots not given (picture, band icon, type description, attachments, address)

host.implementedBy: `EmploymentRows` of `employment-rows` through the host's own component, with `findOrganizationRecords` of `org-hierarchy` and the shell's name for the holding vault; no work-place slot
